Seiko took in her granddaughter Momo when she was little and wanted to pass on a bit of her skills as a spirit medium to her, instructing her to perform a daily spell routine that would potentially help her release her ki. Following her grandmother's instructions, Momo faced bullying from children whenever she performed the daily spell in public. This resulted in Momo blaming Seiko for the mistreatment and accusing her of being a fraudulent spirit medium, a claim that affected her deeply. Over time, their relationship began to heal after Momo apologized to Seiko.
